description: Admin UI surface for viewing individual MCP server detail. Must include: server name, all 7 signal scores with visual indicators, composite verdict badge, attestation status, threat associations count, risk register entry, last_assessed timestamp, first_seen. Must call registry_api.py on :8781 for data. Port 8790 binding. Use same styling as sentinel_status.html and dashboard.html. No direct DB access — all data via API.
